messages:
Asha V: Quick: postmortem actions from the tokenization/regression incident. We need clear owners for: adversarial prompt bucket, nightly soak, a micro chaos drill (KV pause + worker eviction), and an automated replay harness. Who volunteers?
Marco P: I'll take the adversarial bucket + regression harness. Plan: extract ~120 failing prompts from logs, add 300 synthetic variants, mark incident-origin. PR with prompt json + eval harness by Mon.
Jin H: I'll own the nightly soak + replay harness. Soak spec: 75m at 160 rps with a 10m 3x spike. Replay harness should support deterministic replay from logs. ETA infra PR Wed.
Asha V: Good. For chaos drill we want it small and observable: KV GC pause for 90s + one worker eviction, isolated pool. Can SRE run it with rollback steps ready?
sre-bot: Scheduled mini-chaos window Sat 02:30 UTC; SRE will observe. Created ticket SRE-4820 and linked to TEST-2334.
Marco P: Acceptance criteria suggestions: regression = <1% drop in main quality metric on adversarial bucket; tokenization eval = <0.4% new tokenization errors; soak = p95 < 210ms and retries <0.4%; chaos = recovery within 15m with no persistent cache corruption.
Jin H: Adding telemetry guards: fail soak if token-rate > 35% for >2m or kv_gc_pause_ms > 5000. Will add dashboard widgets for the run.
Asha V: Ops playbook needs rollback commands. I'll draft the snippet for KV snapshot-restore + worker-replace and add to TEST-2334. Marco/Jin please tag me if timelines slip.
ops-bot: Created TEST-2334 "Post-incident: tests + replay + chaos" and added assignees Marco P, Jin H, Asha V. Link: https://redwood.internal/TEST-2334
Marco P: Also will run one sampling-variant (top-p=0.92) in regression to catch decoding-sensitive diffs.
Jin H: I'll include a CI quick-run that runs the adversarial bucket for 20m nightly. Snippet in staging-ci.yaml.
Asha V: Great. Owners recap: Marco = adversarial prompts + regression harness (PR Mon), Jin = soak + replay + CI (PR Wed), Asha = chaos coordination, runbook, and comms. I'll post a short customer-facing blurb after the run. :white_check_mark:
